text: He rules from his angel throne—take notice!
He towers in splendor over all the big names.
You laid things out fair and square; You set down the foundations in Jacob, Foundation stones of just and right ways.
Samuel among those who prayed to him. They prayed to God and he answered them;
And they did what he said; they kept the law he gave them.
(But you were never soft on their sins).
Holy. Yes, holy is God our God.
